# UselessReturn

<Badge type="info" text="info" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" /> 

Group: [Confusing constructs](/rules/#confusing-constructs) · PhpStorm name: `UselessReturnInspection`

Two pointless `return` forms: a bare `return;` as the very last statement of a
function body (the function ends there anyway), and `return $local = expr;`
where the assignment to a local variable can never be observed after the
function has returned.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{11,16,22} [Before]
<?php
function build(array $parts, &$out) {
    $memo = null;
    $join = function ($sep, &$acc) use (&$memo, $parts) {
        if ($memo !== null) {
            return $memo = implode($sep, $parts);
        }
        if ($acc === []) {
            return $acc = $parts;
        }
        return $sep = strtoupper($sep);
    };
    if ($out) {
        return $out = $join;
    }
    return $parts = $join;
}

function clear(array &$rows) {
    if (!$rows) { return; }
    $rows = [];
    return;
}

function counter() {
    static $n = 0;
    return $n = $n + 1;
}

function guarded() {
    try {
        return $res = compute();
    } finally {
        release($res);
    }
}

function wrapped() {
    return ($tmp = compute());
}
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
function build(array $parts, &$out) {
    $memo = null;
    $join = function ($sep, &$acc) use (&$memo, $parts) {
        if ($memo !== null) {
            return $memo = implode($sep, $parts);
        }
        if ($acc === []) {
            return $acc = $parts;
        }
        return strtoupper($sep);
    };
    if ($out) {
        return $out = $join;
    }
    return $join;
}

function clear(array &$rows) {
    if (!$rows) { return; }
    $rows = [];
    return;
}

function counter() {
    static $n = 0;
    return $n = $n + 1;
}

function guarded() {
    try {
        return $res = compute();
    } finally {
        release($res);
    }
}

function wrapped() {
    return ($tmp = compute());
}
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 11: The assigned variable is never used after returning; return the value directly.</li>
<li>line 16: The assigned variable is never used after returning; return the value directly.</li>
<li>line 22: Redundant &#39;return;&#39; at the end of the body; remove it.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "UselessReturn": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore UselessReturn

/**
 * @noinspection UselessReturnInspection
 */
```
